# Using Brex in AI apps 

Get answers to all of your questions regarding Brex

**URL Source:** https://www.brex.com/support/using-brex-in-ai-apps

---

## Overview

Brex in AI assistants (ChatGPT and Claude) lets you quickly access your Brex information without leaving your AI workspace.

Review the W_hat you can do_ section below to view the list of capabilities. 

### What you can do

#### Cards (without card numbers)

**Read functionality**

- List cards and card settings.
- List expense policies.
- Get card shipping details.

**Write functionality (individual and bulk actions)**

- Create/update a purchasing card (admin only).
- Create/update an employee card (admin only).
- Ship a physical card.
- Cancel a card.
- Replace a card.
- Lock/unlock a card.
- Rename a card.
- Assign a limit to a card.
- Transfer a card.

#### Spend limits

**Read functionality**

- View available limits, remaining balance, and period.
- List limit groups.
- View a limit group's details: default amount, period, dates, parent budget, rollover, and which cards can spend.
- View limit increase requests: find requests waiting for your approval, check the status of your own requests, and review the request history on a spend limit. To approve, reject or file a request, use the Brex dashboard.

#### Reimbursements

**Read functionality**

- Check payout ETAs for approved reimbursements.
- See which spend limits you can charge a reimbursement to.

**Write functionality (your own reimbursements)**

- Create a reimbursement draft from a receipt.
- Update the amount, memo or spend limit on a draft.
- Submit a reimbursement for approval, after you confirm.
- Remove receipts from a reimbursement, or cancel a draft or a submitted reimbursement.

#### Receipts

**Write functionality**

- Upload a receipt. Attach a PDF or photo to a card expense or a reimbursement or let Brex match it to a card expense. You can also hold it for a reimbursement you file later.
- Upload a trip's receipts at once. Brex attaches the ones it can match, and your AI assistant offers to file the rest as reimbursement drafts.

**Read functionality**

- Check whether a receipt you uploaded matched an expense.

#### Tasks and comments

**Read functionality**

- See all the tasks that need your attention in Brex — across your own expenses, requests pending your review, and more.
- Read the comments on an expense, budget request or trip.

**Write functionality**

- Reply to a comment, and dismiss comments you were tagged in.

#### Billing

**Read functionality**

- List your billing groups, see the balance for each, and list billed card transactions for a group. Reimbursements aren't included yet.

#### Accounting

**Read functionality**

- Check your active accounting integration, view GL accounts, and look up accounting records by source type or review status.
- List fields.
- List field values.

**Write functionality (admins)**

- Create Brex accounting fields, such as Project, Cost Center or Grant.
- Add, rename and disable the values people can choose for those fields.
- Fields that sync from your ERP or HRIS can't be changed this way, so your accounting data stays in step with your ERP.

#### Expenses

**Read functionality**

- Query transactions, card expenses, and reimbursements with filters by date range, merchant, employee, department, compliance status, or spend limit.
- Identify items missing receipts.

#### Banking

**Read functionality**

- View business account balances and monitor cash positions.
- Look up banking transactions: wires, ACH, checks, and transfers.

#### Vendors & Bills

**Read functionality**

- Look up vendors, view bills and purchase orders, get account balance information, and review vendor activity history.

#### Travel

**Read functionality**

- View upcoming trips, flight and hotel bookings, group events, and policy compliance, across your team or company-wide.

#### Reporting

**Read functionality**

- Generate and download account statements in multiple formats for bookkeeping or period-end reporting.

#### User and department administration

**Read functionality**

- Search users, departments, cost centers, and locations. This is useful for admins doing audits or onboarding workflows.

**Admins (optional):** Card admin and account admin can ask high-level company spend questions.

**Tip:** Add filters like a date range, merchant, or amount to narrow results.

## Brex in ChatGPT

<!-- plans: Early access -->

Use the **Brex app in ChatGPT** to quickly see your Brex information without leaving ChatGPT. You can check recent expenses, find items that need receipts, view reimbursement payout ETAs, look up your cards (without card numbers), and see your spend limits. You can also file reimbursements, attach receipts, and reply to comments.

**Important:** Card admins can also manage cards, such as creating, locking, and shipping cards. To approve or reject expenses or edit memos, use the Brex dashboard or Brex mobile app.

**Card details and security:**

- When you use the Brex app in ChatGPT, you connect your own OpenAI account to the Brex app via MCP. Requests are processed using your OpenAI account and API instance. Your queries and responses are processed by OpenAI in accordance with your organization’s ChatGPT plan and OpenAI’s data retention and privacy policies. Please refer to your organization’s agreement with OpenAI and OpenAI’s privacy documentation for details on data handling and retention practices.
- Brex AI integrations (ChatGPT, Claude, Slack, and Brex MCP) do not expose full card numbers, CVVs, or expiration dates. Card tools only return non-sensitive details such as card name, status, last four digits where applicable, and spend limits.

### Get started

### Admins (One time)

**Step 1:** Open the Brex dashboard.

**Step 2:** Go to _Settings_ > _Early access_ and select _Brex MCP access_.

**Step 3:** In ChatGPT, go to _Workspace Settings_ > _Apps_ > _Directory_ and search for “Brex”

**Step 4:** Select _Enable_, configure actions that should be available to your organization (optional) and select _Publish_.

**Step 5**: Let your team know they can connect to Brex within ChatGPT.

**Note:** If you do not see the integration, navigate to _ChatGPT > Apps > Search for “Brex” > Connect._

### Employees

**Step 1:** In ChatGPT, open the _Brex app in ChatGPT._

**Step 2:** Select _Connect_, then select _Connect Brex_ and sign in with your email associated to Brex (single sign-on if configured in your Brex account).

**Step 3:** Review and approve the permission request. You will see a confirmation when connected.

**Step 4:** Ask a question to get started, for example:

- "Show me my recent expenses"
- "Which of my expenses are missing receipts?"
- "What is my remaining balance on my T&E spend limit?"
- "What do I need to do in Brex today?"
- "Expense this receipt for my team lunch."

**To disconnect:** In ChatGPT, open the Brex app and select _Disconnect_. You can also revoke access in the Brex dashboard at _Settings > Personal settings > Connected Integrations_.

**Note:** Your admin will need to complete a one-time setup before you can use Brex in ChatGPT. If your organization has an Enterprise account on ChatGPT, please contact your admin to first add Brex to your ChatGPT account.

## Brex in Claude

<!-- plans: Early access -->

Use Brex in Claude to manage your finances without leaving the conversation -- check expenses across your team, view bank account balances, look up vendor bills, track travel bookings, review accounting records, and update memos or receipts on your expenses, file reimbursements, and reply to comments.

The Claude connector allows you to modify memos, receipts, attendees, and spend limits for your own transactions only, and to create, submit and cancel your own reimbursements. Card admins can also manage cards, such as creating, updating, shipping, locking, and canceling cards. To approve or reject expenses, or modify your team’s transactions, use the Brex dashboard or Brex mobile app.

**Card details and security:**

- When you use the Brex in Claude, your queries and responses are processed by Anthropic in accordance with your organization’s Claude plan and Anthropic’s data retention and privacy policies. Please refer to your organization’s agreement with Anthropic and Anthropic’s privacy documentation for details on data handling and retention practices.
- Brex AI integrations (ChatGPT, Claude, Slack, and Brex MCP) do not expose full card numbers, CVVs, or expiration dates. Card tools only return non-sensitive details such as card name, status, last four digits where applicable, and spend limits.

### Get started

### Admins (one-time)

**Step 1:** Open the Brex dashboard.

**Step 2:** Go to _Settings_ > _Early access_ and select _Brex MCP access_.

**Step 3:** In Claude, go to _Organization settings_ > _Connectors_ > _Browse connectors_ and search for “Brex”

**Step 4:** Select _Brex_ and select _Add to your team._

**Step 5**: Let your team know they can connect to Brex within Claude.  


### Employees

**Step 1:** In Claude, go to _Customize > Connectors._

**Step 2:** Select _Brex_ > _Connect_, and sign in with the email associated with your Brex account (single sign-on if configured in your Brex account).

**Step 3:** Approve the permission request. You will see a confirmation when connected.

**Step 4:** Ask a question to get started, for example:

- "Show me my recent expenses"
- "Which of my expenses are missing receipts?"
- "What is my remaining balance on my T&E spend limit?"
- "What do I need to do in Brex today?"
- "Expense this receipt for my team lunch."

**To disconnect:** In Claude, open the Brex connector in Customize and select _Disconnect_. You can also revoke access in the Brex dashboard at _Settings > Personal settings > Connected Integrations_.

**Note:** Your admin will need to complete a one-time setup before you can use Brex in Claude. If your organization has a Team or Enterprise account on Claude, you must contact your admin to add Brex to your Claude account first.



## Brex MCP 

<!-- plans: Early access -->

Brex MCP lets you connect AI assistants like Claude Code, Codex, Slack, or Cursor directly to your Brex account. Once connected, you can ask your AI questions about your company's spending, cards, and expenses in plain language, without leaving your AI tool.

For example, you could ask:

"What did the engineering team spend on SaaS last month?"

"Show me my bank account transactions from the last week?"

"Show me all unapproved reimbursements over $500."

MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open standard that lets AI assistants securely access external tools and data sources. Brex's MCP server uses your existing Brex API credentials and respects the same role-based permissions you've already set up; your AI only sees what your user account is allowed to see.

**Note:** For the full list of available tools and capabilities, see Brex MCP -- Developer Documentation (https://developer.brex.com/docs/mcp).

### MCP security and access control

Brex MCP is available to any Brex account with Developer API access enabled. The AI assistant operates under the permissions of the credentials used to authenticate, and can only access data that the associated user or service account is permitted to view or modify.

If your organization has not yet enabled Developer API access, an admin can do so from _Settings > Developer > API._

**Two ways to authenticate**

- **OAuth**: Scopes are handled for you. When you connect, the MCP server requests exactly the permissions its tools require, and you approve them in the authorization prompt. No manual configuration is needed.
- **API token**: The MCP server respects the scopes provisioned on the token. If a scope is omitted (for example, cards read), the corresponding tools will be unavailable. The server will never attempt to access resources outside what the token permits. You can generate and scope tokens from _Settings > Developer > API._

We recommend granting only the scopes your AI workflow actually needs when using API tokens.

All actions taken via the MCP server are recorded as the MCP client on behalf of the authenticated user when using OAuth.

### Getting started with Brex MCP

Full setup instructions including how to configure your AI client, authenticate with Brex, and scope your API token can be found in the developer documentation: [Set up Brex MCP](https://developer.brex.com/docs/mcp).

At a high level, setup involves the steps below:

**Prerequisites [Admin only]**

1. **Enable early access.** An account admin or card admin enables Brex MCP from _Settings > Early access_ in the Brex Dashboard by selecting _Brex MCP access_.
2. **Accept the Developer API agreement.** An account admin or card admin accepts the agreement from _Settings > Developer._

**To connect to the MCP:** Follow the steps in the [Developer guide](https://developer.brex.com/docs/mcp) to continue setting up.

### Supported AI clients

Brex MCP works with any MCP-compatible AI client, including:



**Claude Code**

Configure via `claude mcp add --transport http brex https://api.brex.com/mcp in your terminal.`



**Codex**

Configure via` codex mcp add brex --url https://api.brex.com/mcp in your terminal.`



**Cursor**

Add the MCP server URL under Cursor's MCP settings



**Slack**

Follow the setup instructions listed [here](https://slack.com/help/articles/52462803708819-Use-Slackbot-to-work-with-other-apps-from-Slack).



More client-specific setup steps are covered in the developer documentation (https://developer.brex.com/docs/mcp).

## Brex in Slackbot via MCP

<!-- plans: Early access -->

Use **Brex in Slackbot** to get answers about your spend and take action on your expenses without leaving Slack. Once connected, you can message **Slackbot** in plain language to check expenses, find items missing receipts, look up cards and spend limits, and update memos or receipts on your own expenses. Admins and bookkeepers can also ask company-wide questions about spend, banking, bills, vendors, travel, and accounting records — scoped to what your Brex role already allows.

Brex in Slackbot requires you to use [Slackbot’s MCP connector](https://slack.com/help/articles/52414744085139-Connect-Slackbot-to-other-apps-with-MCP). The app respects your existing Brex permissions, so you only see and change what your account is allowed to.

You can modify memos, receipts, attendees, and spend limits for your own transactions only, and to create, submit and cancel your own reimbursements. To approve or reject expenses, or change your team's transactions, use the Brex dashboard or Brex mobile app.

**Notes:**

- Slackbot AI features are available on Slack plans with Slack AI, such as **Slack Business+** and **Slack Enterprise+**. A Slack workspace or org admin must install or approve the Brex app before you can connect.
- When you message Slackbot, your queries and responses are processed by Slack in accordance with your organization's Slack plan and Salesforce's data retention and privacy policies. Please refer to your organization's agreement with Slack and Salesforce's privacy documentation for details on data handling and retention practices.

To get started, follow the setup instructions listed [here](https://slack.com/help/articles/52462803708819-Use-Slackbot-to-work-with-other-apps-from-Slack).

## Troubleshooting

### Can’t connect

- Make sure your company has access to the Brex app in ChatGPT.
- Sign in with your **work email** (single sign-on if configured).
- Ask a Brex admin to enable the integration at _Settings > Early access_.

### New tools or features don’t show up

- If you connected before the new tools were added, disconnect and reconnect to approve the new permissions. New tools that need additional permissions can’t be added to an existing connection automatically.
- To reconnect, disconnect Brex using the steps in “Disconnect the app” below, then connect again. For other AI clients, disconnect and connect again the way you set it up.

### Results look incomplete

- Your role may not allow you to access specific data related to expenses or cards. If not access related, try a narrower query (add a date range, merchant, or amount).

### Reimbursement payout date not showing

- The reimbursement may not be **approved** yet, or a payout date has not been scheduled.

### Receipt didn't attach to an expense

- Ask your AI assistant whether the receipt matched an expense, for example “Did the receipt I uploaded this morning end up on an expense?”
- If it didn't match, name the expense to attach it to, or ask your AI assistant to file a reimbursement from it.

### Reimbursement wasn't submitted

- A draft isn't submitted until you confirm. Ask your AI assistant to submit it.
- You can only charge a reimbursement to a spend limit that allows reimbursements. Ask “Which limit should I charge this to?”

### Can't change an accounting field

- Fields that sync from your ERP or HRIS can't be changed through your AI assistant. Change them in your ERP or HRIS.

### Troubleshooting MCP

Follow the steps [here](https://developer.brex.com/docs/mcp#troubleshooting) to troubleshoot MCP.

### Disconnect the app

### In ChatGPT

- In ChatGPT, open the Brex app in ChatGPT and select **Disconnect**.
- In the Brex dashboard, revoke access at _Settings > Personal settings > Connected Integrations_ if needed.

### In Claude

- In Claude, open the Brex connector in _Customize_ > _Connectors_ in Claude and select **Disconnect**.
- In the Brex dashboard, revoke access at _Settings > Personal settings > Connected Integrations_ if needed.
